find: const asked = requested > 0 ? ` of ${requested} requested by --only` : '';
why: Restores the closing line issue #529 was reported against: ran over selected with no requested count beside it. Every number in the line stays correct, which is the point -- "1/1 mutation(s) ran, 0 mismatch(es)" is true and useless when three entries were asked for. The requested count is the only thing that makes an under-run legible.
killedBy: formatRunSummary prints the requested count BESIDE the ran/selected pair when --only was used (issue #529)
